Ships via the `ruflo-core` plugin's own distribution, not this release.

name: v3.59.0 — Real AgentDB HNSW search, Grok Build host, npm README image fix
body:
## Highlights

- **Real AgentDB HNSW vector search** (#4249/#4322): `AgentDBBackend` now wires the separately-exported `agentdb.HNSWIndex` directly, replacing the dead `getController('hnsw')` path that always threw against the real `agentdb` package and was silently caught on every search. Native search now has correct staleness rejection, safe rebuilds after writes, and exact-cosine fallback on any native-capability failure, missing dependency, dimension mismatch, or filtered query. Follow-up (#4319) added test coverage for the WASM-missing disable path and concurrent index builds.
- **RaBitQ index now builds automatically** (#4318/#4319): previously required a manual build step; now builds on demand with safe fallback to exact search.
- **New: Grok Build CLI host** (#3512): `init` now supports Grok Build as a first-class agent host alongside Claude Code and Codex.
- **New: memory tag filtering** (#3526): `memory list`/`memory search` gained a tag filter, explicit-provider precedence, and an Ollama default model.

## Fixes

- Memory delete-sync: `AutoMemoryBridge.importFromAutoMemory()` now removes entries whose source file/heading was deleted, instead of being additive-only (#4138).
- Swarm idle-agent heartbeat false positive: healthy idle agents (no in-flight work) were being marked `error` and dropped from `getAvailableAgents()` after 3 missed heartbeat intervals, even though they have no heartbeat producer to begin with (#4320).
- Ephemeral-agent termination idempotency: `FederationHub.terminateAgent()`/`completeAgent()` could double-count the same agent's completion/failure on a repeated call (shutdown, `unregisterSwarm`, TTL cleanup, or a retried request) (#4323).
- `status tasks` always printed "No tasks": it sent `status: 'all'` as a literal filter (matching nothing) and read the wrong field names from `task_list`'s response (#4321).
- `task_list`'s `total` count was computed after applying `limit`, so it always equaled the page size instead of the real match count (#4324).
- `metaharness similarity`'s cost dimension was inert below $0.999 (an algebraic no-op collapsed the whole realistic cost range to 0), and the `minor-drift` verdict threshold had two disagreeing encodings (#3520).
- `ruflo-harness` now reports the live process instead of just the install (#3521).

## Documentation

- Fixed the actual cause of broken images/links on npmjs.com/package/ruflo: a stray `repository.directory: "ruflo"` field in `ruflo/package.json` was adding an extra path layer on top of the README content (which is the repo-root README, copied in verbatim at publish time with repo-root-relative paths already). Removed the field to match `claude-flow`'s own repository entry.

## Published

- `@claude-flow/cli@3.59.0`, `claude-flow@3.59.0`, `ruflo@3.59.0` — `latest`/`alpha`/`v3alpha` dist-tags all verified on the live registry.
- `@claude-flow/memory@3.0.8` (standalone, the #4249 fix — not bundled into the 3-package train).

name: v3.58.1 — CWE-22 fix, CLI parser fix, TokenOptimizer fix
body:
## [3.58.1] - 2026-10-20

Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.58.1. Bug fixes only.

### Fixed

- **Security**: `hooks_codemod`'s `resolveTargets()` path-containment check used an unanchored `abs.startsWith(cwd)` string-prefix comparison — a sibling directory merely starting with the project directory's name (e.g. `cwd`-staging) passed containment, letting this live, CLAUDE.md-recommended tool read **and write** outside the project root (CWE-22). Anchored both call sites at a path-separator boundary, matching the already-correct `isWithinPrefix()` pattern used elsewhere in this codebase (#4312/#4313).
- `CommandParser.parse()` flipped `parsingFlags = false` on every literal `--` token it saw, not just the first — a later `--` supplied as an ordinary operand (e.g. a search query of exactly `--`) was silently swallowed instead of being kept as a positional (#4310/#4314).
- `TokenOptimizer.optimizedEdit()` called `agentBooster.editCode()`, a method that has never existed on `agentic-flow/agent-booster`'s real exports; a separate bug in the same file's `initialize()` picked the un-instantiated `AgentBooster` class instead of calling the package's `getAgentBooster()` factory. Published standalone as `@claude-flow/integration@3.0.2` (#4311/#4315).
- CI reliability: `scripts/__tests__/probe-mod-guards.test.mjs` (a `node:test` file) was never categorized into either the vitest-baseline or vitest-excluded list, causing an intermittent, unrelated "no test suite found" failure on PRs that don't touch it (#4316).

### Added

- `ruflo-console` 0.44.6: the compact nav's menu, groups, search and page tabs are now separated by a dim `│` bar instead of just a gap (#3664).

name: v3.58.0 — critical install fix + TUI mouse/menu fixes + memory peek
body:
## [3.58.0] - 2026-10-20

Minor release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.58.0. Backward-compatible additions (new `memory peek` command, a Codex session activity viewer, configurable MCP rate limits) plus a critical install-breaking fix and a round of correctness fixes.

### Fixed

- **Critical**: `@claude-flow/cli@3.57.2` pinned `@claude-flow/memory@3.0.6`, which had never been published, so every fresh install of the 3.57.x line failed with `ETARGET` (#4303). Published `@claude-flow/memory@3.0.6` standalone (verified against a clean install) and added `scripts/audit-leaf-versions-published.mjs` — a new, now-required CI check that queries the live npm registry for every non-bundled leaf pin so a PR that bumps a pin ahead of its own leaf's publish fails before merge, not after release (#4304).
- `agent spawn --name` was accepted and echoed by the CLI but never persisted to the `AgentRecord`, so `ruflo-console` could only label agents by type (#4300/#4301).
- `agent list --all` sent a literal `status: 'all'` that `agent_list` doesn't recognize, filtering out every agent; `agent list --type` was accepted but never read (#4302).
- `claims_claim`'s `expiresAt` was declared but unsettable by any handler, and the claims-load utilization math duplicated the max-claims threshold as a second magic literal (#3180/#3927).
- A stale docstring on `InMemoryClaimRepository` claimed SQLite-backed persistence that doesn't exist in this package (#3179/#3926).
- The persistent embedding cache raced concurrent cold callers into redundant SQLite initializations, and its FNV-1a cache key could collide for distinct equal-length inputs, including the lone-surrogate case (#3685, #3681).
- The embedding model cache directory could be unwritable for non-root runtime users, permanently caching the mock fallback with no retry path (#3692/#3831).
- `ruflo-mods`' risky-call/event classifier was missing several calls and hook events (`agent.register`, `tool.call`, `session.append`, read-side forgery vectors like `fs.read`/`env.get`, and more) that can rewrite or forge what other mods decide by — strictly widened, nothing un-flagged (#3802).
- `ruflo-x-gateway` could crash on a malformed relay frame instead of failing fast on the one relay connection affected (#3921).
- The standalone terminal console (`npx ruflo tui`) gave no on-screen indication that mouse support is off by default, silently dropped the `0 menu` hint from the footer below 80 columns, and dropped a mouse press+release pair when a terminal (tmux especially) coalesced them into one data chunk (#4305).
- CI reliability, found while validating this release (#4307): `v3/@claude-flow/memory`'s FTS5 tests located `sql-wasm.wasm` via a `sql.js/package.json` subpath resolve, which sql.js 1.14's tightened `exports` map rejects even though the file exists — now resolves `sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm` directly; `plugins/ruflo-business-pods/scripts/pod-tick.test.mjs` (a `node:test` file) was miscategorized into the vitest-can-run-it baseline instead of the node:test-only exclusion list (#4308); `plugins/ruflo-graph-intelligence`'s knowledge-graph adapter built its optional `@claude-flow/cli` import specifier as a string literal that a bundler's static scan could eagerly (and wrongly) try to resolve during test collection, outside the method's own try/catch — now built from joined parts; the root test-suite ratchet's default vitest worker count intermittently crashed with `ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED` partway through the ~9500-test suite — capped at 2 workers as a stopgap pending real root-cause work; `tests/all-plugins-smoke-workflow.test.mjs`'s hardcoded `timeout-minutes: 10` expectation went stale when #3950 raised the real value to 15 for the new external-plugin smoke step.

### Added

- `memory peek` — a read-only command that reports which store files the current directory resolves to, row counts, last-write time, and WAL state, without ever creating, initializing, or migrating anything (#3508/#3620).
- `@claude-flow/codex activity` — inspect a Codex helper's assignment, recorded state, progress, and tool calls/results from an existing session, with symlink-safe, TOCTOU-resistant file access and best-effort credential masking in previews (#3930/#3962).
- `mcp start` now supports configurable HTTP and per-session rate limits (#3694).

name: v3.57.2 — graph/backup/ttl correctness fixes + large community PR batch
body:
Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.57.2. `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.5 (#4295, #4296) published standalone and pinned exactly. A large community PR batch — mostly correctness fixes to error reporting, memory/graph boundary handling, and CLI diagnostics.

### Fixed

- `agentdb_graph-query`/`agentdb_graph-pathfinder` resolved the memory DB path ad hoc instead of through the shared `resolveDbPath()` priority order, so an explicit `CLAUDE_FLOW_DB_PATH` binding could silently read a different store than the one selected (#4291, #4298).
- `backupMemoryDb()` fell back to a raw file copy after *any* native online-backup failure — including ordinary `SQLITE_BUSY`/disk errors on an unencrypted source — and reported `backedUp: true` regardless; the fallback is now gated on a confirmed-encrypted source with no active WAL, and the result records which method actually completed (#4287, #4297).
- `JsonMemoryBackend.isExpired()` used a falsy check on `ttlSeconds`, so an explicit `ttl: 0` never expired (`cli-core` 3.7.5, #4295, #4296).
- `RvfBackend`'s native `@ruvector/rvf` branch could never succeed (wrong `open()` call) and silently fell back to the pure-TS path; the dead native branch is removed rather than half-wired (#4278, #4279, #4280).
- `ReasoningBank.consolidate()` deleted pruned/deduplicated patterns from storage but never called `hnswIndex.removePoint(id)`, so the HNSW index filled with orphans until `storePattern()` started throwing permanently (#4270, #4271).
- `TopologyManager`'s queen/coordinator failover never promoted a replacement after death despite `failoverEnabled: true`, silently falling through to generic mesh-style ranking (#4285, #4286).
- `memory export`, `memory import`, and `memory_migrate` reported fabricated success text instead of the tool's real error or migrated count (#4204/#4207, #4194/#4209, and the memory-import tool failure fix).
- `hooks worker dispatch` printed `Status: completed` even when no daemon ran anything (#4196/#4208).
- `hooks_intelligence_attention` accepted unimplemented modes instead of rejecting them (#4193).
- `init upgrade` now refreshes `intelligence.cjs`/session companions instead of leaving stale copies behind (#4198/#4220).
- SmartRetrieval collapsed multi-result searches down to one (#4192); the ReasoningBank embedder used a hash fallback instead of the real embedder (#4191); `@claude-flow/cli`'s own `package.json` wasn't exported for consumers resolving it directly (#4190).
- `ruvocal`'s MCP server merge dropped a base server's credentials when the browser echoed the server back without headers (#4281).
- `ruflo-x-gateway` now advertises `offline_access` so OAuth clients can refresh silently instead of re-authenticating on every access-token expiry (#4256).
- `workflow list/status/stop/run` now read the actual shape and errors the workflow tools return (#4268); stale task owners are released on terminal states (#4272); unregistering a swarm agent now removes its domain-pool membership (#4269); orphaned atomic-write temp files under the policy lock are reaped (#3164/#4273); one-shot CLI runs now flush learned patterns before `process.exit(0)` instead of losing them while `stats.json` keeps counting (#4283/#4284).
- `ruflo-console`'s mission ledger no longer leaks a mission from one project into every other project's cockpit (#4254/#4276).
- Command examples in the user guide that failed when copied are fixed (#4275); a stray `npx` invocation referencing a nonexistent unscoped package is corrected to `@claude-flow/codex` (#4265).
- `scripts/build-codex-mod-hooks.mjs` now rebuilds the codex-mod bundle the same way on every OS (#4292).

name: v3.57.1 — env-denylist hardening + native bundle drift fix
body:
Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.57.1. `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.4 (#4229, #4230) was published earlier and is pinned exactly.

### Security

- `DENYLISTED_ENV_NAMES` now blocks the credential/command-hijack and interpreter-flag-injection vars that 2026-09-21's env-sanitizer fix missed: `GIT_ASKPASS`, `GIT_PROXY_COMMAND`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`, `PERL5OPT`, `RUBYOPT`, `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`, `_JAVA_OPTIONS`, `JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS`, `PYTHONHOME`, `CLASSPATH`, `PYTHONSTARTUP`, plus git's numbered `GIT_CONFIG_(COUNT|KEY_\d+|VALUE_\d+)` family via a new regex (`cli-core` 3.7.4, #4229, #4230).

### Fixed

- `all-plugins-smoke`: the adr/ddd/sparc codex-mod native hook bundles are rebuilt, clearing the native-bundle-drift failure that had been hitting every push to `main`; `scripts/build-codex-mod-hooks.mjs` also no longer hard-fails on Windows, where `execFileSync` can't invoke a `.cmd` shim directly (#4266, #4277, @uyg7x).

name: v3.57.0 — community PR batch + policy-ledger integrity fix
body:
Minor release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.57.0. A batch of community and dream-cycle fixes (#4210-#4252) plus a policy-ledger integrity fix (#3892). No standalone leaf republish needed this round.

### Security

- `ruflo init` / `init --dual` / `@claude-flow/codex init` no longer write a permissive `.codex/config.toml` by default. The generated file now uses `sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"`, `approval_policy = "on-request"` and `web_search = "cached"` (**standard** trust); the old `danger-full-access` / `never` / `live` file needs an explicit `--codex-trust full` (or `RUFLO_CODEX_TRUST=full`). `init` prints which level was written, an existing `.codex/config.toml` is never rewritten (not even with `--force`), and a kept permissive file is flagged with how to tighten it. Found by the three-host e2e run (ADR-490). `@claude-flow/codex` 3.0.4 (bundled, ships with the next train).
- The MCP bridge on loopback no longer accepts tool-call requests from an arbitrary web page: local-only mode now requires the `Host` to be loopback (blocks DNS rebinding) and the `Origin` to be loopback-or-allowlisted when no `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` is set (#4226, #4243, @kevin9327).
- The policy ledger now authenticates a retained/pruned ledger against its independent on-disk archive anchor instead of trusting the mutable `state.json` alone, and streams full audits through fenced writers. Fixes `policy-ledger-verification-failed` on any install whose ledger has already been pruned (#3892, #4216, @proffesor-for-testing).

### Added

- `ruflo doctor` reports `better-sqlite3` copies compiled against Node 24.19+ headers when running Node 24.19–24.21, where they can abort the process (`Assertion failed: (env) != nullptr`, nodejs/node#65446), with the documented workarounds. `doctor --component native-addon` runs it alone (#4055, reported by @ronmikailov).
- `ruflo doctor` reports health checks as versioned JSON output (#4228, @bryanbans).

### Fixed

- `@metaharness/darwin` pin bumped from `~0.10.2` to `~0.12.0`, unblocking the `metaharness-pin-drift` CI gate repo-wide (#3219, #4252).
- Swarm: subscriber delivery is cancelled cleanly at shutdown, acknowledgements are tracked per recipient, urgent messages survive queue overflow, and failed/cancelled task workers release their slot (#4233, #4234, #4235, #4236, @rudycelekli). Coordinator cancellation stays terminal (#4244, @rudycelekli); domain pools stop creating unregistered agents and release agents after terminal tasks (#4246, #4247, @Tong-bit-art); shared worker reservations are honored across agent pools, fixing a case where that bookkeeping change would have silently defeated the domain-pool-release fix above (#4245, @rudycelekli).
- Learning stats read-merge-write transactions are serialized across processes, fixing lost concurrent increments (#4217, #4240, @rudycelekli).
- Claude memories refresh across project and worktree roots (#4210, @rudycelekli); the secret screen no longer treats a hyphen-named memory key as a credential field (#4202, #4211, @akushonkamen).
- Hook lifecycle events are distinguished during deduplication, fixing the Stop hook claiming the session-end de-dup key so later hooks never ran (#4206, #4212, @dajiaohuang); `init` omits unimplemented generated hooks (#4200, #4213, @dajiaohuang) and stops granting blanket execution of project helpers (#4221, @xiajiahang).
- Intelligence: trajectories are forwarded using the ruvllm contract (#4222, @xiajiahang); neural quantization reports unchanged persisted storage instead of a false delta (#4224, @dajiaohuang).
- Console: Mission Control's prose wraps at 80 columns (#3899, #4225, console 0.44.3, @korjavin); the mission ledger is keyed per project instead of leaking one project's active mission into every other (#4237, #4242, @kevin9327).
- `daemon status` reports the running daemon's actual TTL instead of a stale `--ttl 0` default (#4238, #4241, @kevin9327).
- CLI: `--no-color` is honored for help and version output, and `--no-update` is honored before the startup update check runs (#4248, #4251, @shuaiyafei).
- `dream(performance)`: `RaftConsensus.awaitConsensus()` is event-driven instead of busy-polling (#4214, #4215).
- Docs: 25 user guide links repaired to v3 packages (#4223, @ketpatil77); ABP-governed SGit memory checkpoints and Ruflo CLI recovery validation documented (#4239, @mondweep).

Not included: #4220 (helper-execution-permission fix) touches a signed helper manifest and needs a re-sign with the private key before merge, held for a follow-up release. #4216's own large diff (ledger integrity) was reviewed in depth separately before merging, given it gates MCP tool-call authorization.

name: v3.56.10 — TUI pictures and looks, MCP project cwd and daemon fixes, memory and analyze fixes
body:
Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.10 (latest, alpha, v3alpha). The CLI pins `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.5 (#4183) and `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.3 (#3987), both published earlier, plus `shared` 3.0.5, `security` 3.0.5 and `codex` 3.0.5 exactly. Signed helpers changed in #4178 and were re-signed there.

### Added
- **`ruflo tui`** draws the console's pictures, looks and motion (console 0.44.x, #4182, #4188): `--look bbs|orbital|plain`, `--fps`, `--anim`, `--pictures`, `--boot`, and any console view with `--view`. It draws at the default size when the terminal reports 0 columns (#4160, @martinvlad).

### Changed
- `ruflo init`: the v3 implementation skills are opt-in (`--full` adds them), like `agents.v3` (#4140, #4139, @z4forzubair).

### Fixed
- **MCP server and daemons**: the server starts in the session project and ignores a `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD` that names the home directory or a filesystem root (`cli-core` 3.7.3); user-level claims resolve through `os.homedir()` on Windows; duplicate or zombie daemons per workspace are stopped (#3987, @socrates6969). Trajectory counts persist across processes and daemon jobs feed learning (#3988, @socrates6969). One node process per MCP session, with `node:http` and the security barrel kept off the startup path (#3989, @socrates6969).
- Console reads the project on Windows (a drive path is absolute) (#4177, #4175). Neural data dir resolves through the project cwd; stored worker error text is capped.
- **Hooks and core**: failed tool outcomes are recorded, hooks run from the project root, telemetry stays off the tool path (#4178).
- **Memory**: calibrated default search threshold with near-miss hints (#4184, #4129); `memory_export` reads the CLI store as well as AgentDB (#4186, #4148); the AgentDB directory is created before the bridge opens it (#4155, #4132, @martinvlad); `TieredMemoryStore` recalls multi-word and natural-language queries (`memory` 3.0.5, #4183, #4152).
- **Intelligence**: long memories recalled for short route prompts (#4172, @rudycelekli); SONA reinforces the nearest pattern for near-identical tasks (#4185, #4134); AIDefence learns missed threats and autopilot learning loads (#4187, #4147, #4146).
- **Workflow and agents**: invalid gates and unsupported steps fail closed (#4164); agent health derives from observed execution outcomes (#4167) (@rudycelekli).
- **Analyze**: classification from diff content and commit subjects, safe Git revision ranges, encryption paths flagged security-sensitive, accurate reviewer-role docs (#4165, #4162, #4169, #4163, @rudycelekli).
- **Security scan**: interpolated `exec` calls after imports are detected (#4166, @rudycelekli); a failed `npm audit` reports "could not scan" instead of a clean tree (#4154, #4124, @martinvlad).
- Clear "not installed" message for `@ruvector/rvagent-wasm`; only new patterns are counted (#4179, #3979). Skills, plugin contracts and ruvector/neural/kg surfaces (#4181).

### Notes
- `@claude-flow/browser` (agent-browser bump, #4130) is a standalone package outside this train and was not republished.

### Thanks
@rudycelekli, @martinvlad, @proffesor-for-testing, @ronmikailov, @z4forzubair, @socrates6969, @nicholas-ruest and @pacphi for the fixes and reports across 3.56.6 to 3.56.10.

name: v3.56.9 — policy envelope metering, Codex MCP backend retired, CLI parser fixes, ruflo-mods guards
body:
Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.9 (latest, alpha, v3alpha). The bundled leaves `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.5 and `@claude-flow/codex` 3.0.5 were published standalone first, and the CLI pins them, `@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.5 and `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.2 exactly. Signed helpers changed (`hook-handler.cjs`, re-signed in #4096).

### Fixed
- **Policy envelope** (`security` 3.0.5): explicit envelope ceilings require metering, and unmetered worker ceilings stay opt-in (#3503, @rudycelekli).
- **Codex MCP backend** (`codex` 3.0.5 and the ruflo wrapper bridge): the opt-in `codex` backend no longer launches `@openai/codex mcp-server`, which current Codex CLI dropped, and is retired without a startup stall (#3522, @rudycelekli; reported in #3509 by @pacphi).
- **CLI parser, retry, rate-limit, monitoring and config fixes**: a reviewed batch (#4107, covering #4000-#4017, @rudycelekli and others).
- `analyze diff` renders the `analyze_diff` result shape (#4102, fixes #4101, @z4forzubair).
- `shared` 3.0.5 and `cli-core` 3.7.2: narrow-column truncation, rate-window retry times, structured network error codes (#4014, #4015, #4018, @rudycelekli).
- **ruflo-mods guards** (#4096, @proffesor-for-testing): the root-delete guard no longer misses brace, nesting and fork-bomb forms, the screen `.env` check is fixed, and `init`-generated hooks carry the changes.
- **Console** (marketplace plugin; its `tui.mjs` is bundled into the CLI): worktree removal runs no fsmonitor or hooks and keeps untracked files (#4092), `console_state` reports an expired confirm card (#4067), pictures draw as SVG on Claude Code Desktop (#4112), all by @proffesor-for-testing; the Skills page pins its skills CLI (#4113, @martinvlad).
- `ruflo-cost-tracker` logs Stop-hook telemetry write failures instead of discarding them (#3227, @nicholas-ruest; marketplace plugin).
- CI runs every v3 root-suite test file and no longer accepts a crashed run as a pass (#4099, @proffesor-for-testing); not part of the package.

### Thanks
@rudycelekli, @proffesor-for-testing, @z4forzubair, @nicholas-ruest, @martinvlad, @ronmikailov (whose reports shaped the 3.56.7 and 3.56.8 trains) and @pacphi.

name: ruflo-console 0.43.0: Orbital look and Theme Studio
body:
## ruflo-console 0.43.0: optional Orbital look and Theme Studio

Classic BBS stays the default. Orbital is opt-in; nothing changes until you pick it.

### Changelog
- **feat:** an optional **Orbital** look: black telemetry panels, square borders, a rotating globe, a scan sweep and a shaded RUFLO header that stays visible after boot (Main Menu, Theme Studio, Swarm), animated real boot checks, a perspective swarm preview.
- **feat:** **Theme Studio** (Main Menu → Tools, Settings, or `/ruflo themes`): pick Classic BBS, Terminal plain or Orbital; six bundled color presets; up to twelve named custom themes saved through host storage; a color picker with a 3:1 minimum contrast; motion layers and speed; `fps` 0 freezes the frame.
- **feat:** a bundled `generate-console-theme` skill (`allowed-tools: Read`) returns data-only palette/motion JSON for Claude or Codex; import goes through a strict, 4096-character-bounded schema.
- **fix:** Theme Studio has a boot-log line and a help guide and is reached by name; the wide Orbital header says RUFLO, not RUVNET.
- **chore:** the globe reads a one-degree land mask built once (about a third less time per frame); `scripts/bench-theme.mjs`; no Python in the repo (the SVG demo exporter is Node).

### Validation
- Console tests: 0 failing (main and this release both skip 29 files that need `claude-code/testing`); 3193 pass (+77). Console smoke 20/20; manifest, mcp-prefix, skill-frontmatter, hook audits and `claude plugin validate` pass; CI 114 checks green.
- Checked in the real Claude Code 2.1.289 (isolated config, directory marketplace, tmux, frames viewed): `/ruflo`, Orbital and Classic, Tools → Theme Studio, `/ruflo themes`, colour edit, contrast guard, save and reload across a full restart, "Use configured look", malformed/hostile JSON rejected with the theme unchanged, animation running (12/12 distinct frames) and stopped at `fps` 0, resizes 300→150 columns, clean model-facing `console_state` (no escapes, no theme JSON).
- 45 adversarial specs on import, stores and model-facing text found no defect. Classic BBS per-tick cost is unchanged from before.

### Not verified
Windows and macOS terminals, other emulators (tmux 256-colour only), the desktop and VS Code surfaces, a real AI-generated theme round trip (Generate with Claude/Codex was not run), and some stray `│` cells right of the pane after a shrink-resize in tmux (looks like host diff-render residue). The side-by-side editor layout needs a pane of 100+ columns (the host's default share is narrower; `RUFLO_CONSOLE_COLUMNS` widens it).

### Install
Marketplace plugin, not npm: `claude plugin marketplace update ruflo` then `claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo`, and restart Claude Code.

PR [#4079](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/pull/4079). Orbital and Theme Studio by @ruvnet (with Codex); review, fixes, validation and optimization by RuFlo.

name: v3.56.7 — ruflo tui, MCP resources, auto-memory and purge fixes, safer init --dual
body:
Feature patch: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.7 (latest, alpha, v3alpha) and `@claude-flow/codex` 3.0.4 (published standalone; the CLI pins it exactly).

### Added
- **`ruflo tui`**: the ruflo console in a terminal of its own (ADR-489, #4059, #4075, #4076). Six pages, opened with `--view` or keys 1-6: Overview, Cost, Swarm, Events, Missions (read-only) and an AI page that asks Codex (pinned 0.162.0, read-only) or OpenRouter, each question after a confirm card. `--no-ai` turns the AI page off; `--max-spend-usd` (default 0.5) stops sending to OpenRouter once provider-reported spend reaches it. `--plain` prints one frame and exits 0; without a terminal it exits 2 with a hint. The CLI tarball now carries the bundled `plugins/ruflo-console/dist/tui.mjs` (about 1.27 MB, 446 KB gzipped; tarball about 3.9 MB). Console 0.42.7 is a marketplace plugin, not npm.
- MCP resources capability on the CLI server, and a three-host integration loop (Claude Code, Codex, OpenRouter) with ADR-490/491 (#4068).
- `doctor` flags a better-sqlite3 built against Node 24.19+ headers on Node 24.19-24.21 (#4069, #4074).
- `ruflo mods`: doctor repairs that repair, `--strict`, atomic install, startup self-check (#4073).

### Fixed
- Auto-memory hooks deliver their subcommand, sync sees learnings, worktrees share the main memory dir, store writes are atomic (#4071, #4058).
- `memory purge` keeps the on-disk format on sql.js write-back (#4057); command recording has an off switch and redaction, and `memory cleanup --expired-only` reaches the bridge store (#4056, #4072).

### Changed
- `init --dual` now writes a safe default `.codex/config.toml`. The old permissive values need `--codex-trust full` (#4070).

### Known
- Nested better-sqlite3 11.x copies under agentdb and agentic-flow still ship. Fixing that needs an agentdb release that depends on better-sqlite3 ^12. `doctor` warns on affected Node versions.

### Thanks
@ronmikailov for the reports behind the Node 24 doctor check, hook-log cleanup, `memory purge` format and auto-memory hook fixes (#4055-#4058); @rudycelekli for the cli-core/shared batch shipped in 3.56.6 that this train builds on; @Devesh-Maheshwari for the cost-tracker Codex usage fix (#4048, 3.56.6).

name: v3.56.3 — AgentDB alpha.20, memory 3.0.3, sql.js lock guard
body:
Patch release: AgentDB `3.0.0-alpha.20` update. `@claude-flow/memory` **3.0.3** (published standalone; the CLI pins it exactly) and `@claude-flow/cli` / `claude-flow` / `ruflo` **3.56.3**. `neural`, `shared`, `cli-core` unchanged.

### Changed
- AgentDB floor `^3.0.0-alpha.17` -> `^3.0.0-alpha.20` (memory, cli, root, ruflo). alpha.20 swaps `@xenova/transformers` for `@huggingface/transformers`, `@ruvector/rvf` 0.1.9 -> 0.2.3, `ruvector` -> 0.2.x.
- Search scores shift slightly (same-text cosine ~0.992 vs alpha.17): an entry that scored just under the 0.3 default threshold can now appear just above it, ranked far below the exact-keyword hit. One regression-test assertion was adjusted for this (PR #3960).

### Fixed
- sql.js stale `<db>.agentdb.lock`: AgentDB alpha.20 refuses saves while the lock exists, and a lock left by a crashed writer was never cleared, so every later save failed and the db file was never created. `@claude-flow/memory` now clears the lock only when provably stale (regular file named exactly `<db>.agentdb.lock`, numeric dead PID, >10 s old, atomic rename-aside + re-verify), retries once, otherwise throws `AgentdbLockError`. A failed persist on shutdown is now surfaced (`ControllerRegistry`, `AgentDBBackend`, `HybridBackend`, `shutdownBridge`) instead of swallowed. Affects only the sql.js path (no native better-sqlite3).
- Dev tree only: `pnpm.packageExtensions` declares `onnxruntime-common` for `@huggingface/transformers@4.2.0`.

### Known / not verified
- agentdb 3.0.0-alpha.20 has no npm provenance attestation (registry signature present).
- Under pnpm 4.2.0 the embedder fell back to mock embeddings before the extension above; npm installs resolve transformers 4.3.1 and were unaffected.
- AgentDB `forceWasm: true` still selects better-sqlite3 unless `AGENTDB_FORCE_SQLJS=1` (upstream behaviour).

PR #3960.

name: v3.56.1 — config, policy-trust and encrypted-store fixes
body:
# ruflo 3.56.1

Patch release: bug fixes only. Published as `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` 3.56.1 (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha`). No leaf package changed since 3.56.0.

## Fixed

- The policy trust mirror and key now honour `HOME` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` instead of a fixed home directory, so a throwaway `HOME` no longer yields `policy-anchor-log-missing` (#3922, fixes #3919, reported by @HF-teamdev).
- `ensureSchemaColumns` rewrites the store only when a column was actually added; an up-to-date encrypted memory store is no longer rewritten by a read such as `memory stats` (#3923, fixes #3918, reported by @HF-teamdev).
- `config reset --section <name>` resets only that section and removes the matching flat overrides, preserving unrelated configuration (#3901, @rudycelekli).
- MCP config tools (`config_get/set/list/export/import/reset`) now work on the plain nested JSON document written by the `config` CLI command instead of assuming a `{values, scopes}` envelope; existing envelope stores keep their format (#3902, @rudycelekli). This does not change how the daemon reads `config.json`.

## Not in the npm release

The console approvals badge fix (#3924, fixes #3920, reported by @HF-teamdev) ships as `ruflo-console` 0.40.3 through the plugin marketplace.

## Verification

Release PR: #3925 (all CI jobs green; merge commit). Local cli suite: 5483 passed, 2 failed (`policy-runtime` worker-envelope test and `router-cjs-esm-3555`); both also fail on v3.56.0 source in a linked-worktree development environment. Witness manifests regenerated for linux, macos and windows (117/117, no drift); helpers manifest re-signed.

Full changelog: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/v3.56.1/CHANGELOG.md

name: v3.56.0 - hardening and correctness batch
body:
# v3.56.0 - hardening and correctness batch

Minor release. Several fixes change behaviour on purpose; they are listed first. Integrated by merging each PR head, so authorship is preserved. Packages: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.0 (tags `latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha`), plus `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.2 and `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3 published standalone first.

## Behaviour changes (read these)

- **Unknown ids and value-less options are errors (#3911, @martinvlad).** `agent status` / `task status` with an unknown id print "not found" and exit 1. A declared string/number option given no value (for example `hooks route --task`) now reports `Option --task needs a value` instead of silently becoming `true`. Applies to every command.
- **Sessions (#3489, #3490, @rudycelekli).** `session_save` captures the persisted task, agent and legacy memory stores by default (explicit `false` still excludes). `session_import` rejects malformed stores before saving and derives counts from the snapshot.
- **Backups (#3903).** The default project backup snapshots both `memory.db` and `agentdb-memory.db` and honors the configured memory directory. `--db` and a non-blank `CLAUDE_FLOW_DB_PATH` still select a single file.
- **Zero values are honored (#3488, #3496).** Scaling an agent pool to 0 no longer creates five workers; invalid targets fail before writing; a zero fallback retry budget is respected.
- **Path validators (#3504, `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3).** Sensitive directory names are blocked anywhere under the project root, not only at the leaf, and the blocked-extension check also applies to synchronous validation.
- **OAuth callback server (#3507, `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3).** Retains an early callback and ignores unrelated requests.
- **Providers (#3493, #3494, #3495).** An explicit execution provider is honored; Anthropic gateway credentials and endpoint (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) are used (fixes #3100); timeouts cover reading the response body.
- **Routing (#3904, #3498).** `hooks_route` now consults persisted SONA outcome patterns before local routing: only a supported agent at confidence >= 0.6 is used, and `useSemanticRouter: false` keeps keyword routing. With the opt-in neural router, model selection uses calibrated quality predictions, so calibration can move a pick across the quality bar.
- **WAL gate (#3894, @nicholas-ruest; fixes #3161).** Leftover `-wal`/`-shm` files from a closed connection no longer block `memory store`/`list`; a genuinely open holder is still refused.
- **`ruflo init` no longer pins a Claude model (#3528, @HF-teamdev; fixes #3527).**
- **`ruflo` wrapper (#3438).** Pins the matching `@claude-flow/cli` and prints a warning if the resolved CLI version differs. It warns and continues; it does not refuse to run. Fixes #3306.
- **Claims (#3502).** CLI and MCP share one lossless claims.json format; unreadable or malformed stores are refused rather than replaced.
- **Native immutable conditional append (#3750, @stuinfla).** New `memory store` flags `--append-only`, `--append-conditions`, `--require-native`, `--no-embedding`. Additive, CLI only.

## Fixes

- Shipped `.claude/settings.json` had unescaped quotes in hook commands and did not parse (#3895, fixes #3888, @nicholas-ruest). A new test checks that every shipped settings/plugin JSON file parses.
- Remaining better-sqlite3 opens use the shared loader (#3896, @nicholas-ruest; supersedes #3884 by @drakeo338); RFE1-encrypted stores are reported as encrypted, not broken (#3906, fixes #2889, @nicholas-ruest); the demo plugin-registry fallback is labelled as unverified (#3897, @martinvlad).
- `analyze` preserves machine-readable JSON (#3910); `doctor` rejects unsupported component selections (#3907) and loads MetaHarness via file URLs on Windows (#3523, fixes #3186); `daemon start` honors explicit workers (#3586).
- Unreadable task/agent records are preserved (#3484); async registry updates do not revive retired agents (#3492); fallback learning is attributed per attempted model (#3497).
- Workflow step boundaries are validated (#3491); persisted workflows resume without duplicate executors (#3500) and keep control signals and sibling state across awaits (#3505).
- Memory JSON import reports rejected writes accurately (#3499); export reads all pages only after successful reads (#3501); concurrent rotating-token refreshes coalesce (#3506).
- Test fixtures isolate pnpm's NODE_PATH (#3543, fixes #3529, @HF-teamdev's report).
- `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.2: cache admission accounts for replacement sizes (#3679, fixes #3678); invalidation matches each key independently (#3687, fixes #3686).
- Handlebars lock entries moved to 4.7.10 after new critical advisories against 4.7.9 (dev tooling only).
- An empty `.claude/agents/tmp.json` no longer ships in the CLI tarball.

Contributors: @rudycelekli, @nicholas-ruest, @martinvlad, @HF-teamdev, @drakeo338, @stuinfla. Thank you.

## Not included, and why

- #3503 (fail-closed policy envelope): on the real MCP dispatch path nothing supplies cost/token/concurrency, so any envelope with a ceiling would deny every tool call; its own updated test shows `concurrency-outside-envelope`. Needs the dispatcher to supply metering.
- #3892 (policy ledger retention): default `policy verify` would stop covering the archive; needs the archive tip anchored or cross-checked, and the home mirror handled.
- #3831 (embedding cache dir): needs a rebase and half of it targets `@claude-flow/embeddings`, which cannot be published from main.
- #3694 (configurable MCP rate limits): needs a ceiling for non-loopback binds.
- #3879/#3622/#3476 (EWC), #3835, #3751, #3909, #3905, #3690, #3776: drafts or decisions pending.

## Verification

Full CLI suite 5408 passed (4 failures that reproduce identically on unmodified main in the release environment), security 611/611, memory suite passes, ruflo wrapper test, umbrella lockstep and leaf audits, witness manifests 117/117 on linux/macos/windows, pnpm frozen install passes the new lockfile and fails the old one.

Release PR #3916: 120 CI checks passed on the final head (3 skipped). Registry check after publish: `latest`, `alpha` and `v3alpha` all point at 3.56.0 for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo`; a clean `npx ruflo@latest --version` reports v3.56.0 with memory 3.0.2 and security 3.0.3, and `mcp start -t http --host 0.0.0.0` refuses without a token.

name: v3.55.0 — MCP HTTP auth gate, hive gating, policy ledger anchor
body:
## Ruflo 3.55.0

Minor release. It contains one security behaviour change that can break existing setups: **`ruflo mcp start -t http` on a non-loopback host now refuses to start without a token.**

### Security

- **MCP HTTP transport (#3598, #3599).** Binding off loopback (`--host 0.0.0.0`, a LAN IP, `::`) now exits 1 unless `RUFLO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN` / `--auth-token-file` / `--auth-token` is set, or you opt out with `RUFLO_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP=1`. With a token, `/rpc`, `/mcp` and `/info` require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (constant-time compare); `/health` stays public and minimal. Also fixes a fail-open in `@claude-flow/mcp` 3.1.0 where auth enabled with an empty token list accepted any bearer value.
  **What is not fixed:** loopback with no token is still unauthenticated. Any local process can call every tool, and DNS rebinding is not blocked (no `Host` allow-list). Set a token whenever you use the HTTP transport. A valid token grants every tool; there is no per-tool authorization.
- **Hive-mind gating (#3338, #3339, ADR-476).** Remote (HTTP/WebSocket) callers now need an operator credential for `spawn`, `consensus propose`, `broadcast`, `shutdown`, `memory set/delete` and `optimize-memory`. Local stdio/CLI users need nothing. `hive-mind_init` no longer returns `hiveToken`. For a local caller this is a speed bump, not a boundary: a prompt-injected agent that can read `.claude-flow/hive-mind/` can read the secret.
- **Policy ledger anchor (#3602, #3886, ADR-475).** Deleting the anchor fields in `state.json` and truncating receipts no longer verifies as valid. A hash-chained anchor log plus a mirror under `~/.config/ruflo/policy-trust/` now detect it. `ruflo policy verify --establish-anchor` (interactive TTY only) is the logged repair path. **Limit:** an attacker who can rewrite both the project directory and `~/.config/ruflo` can still delete every anchor and receipt or forge a coherent log; stronger evidence needs an external witness. A pre-#3568 ledger with receipts and no anchor now fails policy transactions until you run `policy verify --establish-anchor`.

### Fixes

- Shared resilience batch (#3885; #3676 #3674 #3668 #3670 #3682 #3672 #3593 #3592), `@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.2, thanks @rudycelekli.
- Byzantine quorums intersect for every cluster size (#3560, #3587), federation sends use current peer trust (#3561, #3588), both @rudycelekli; `@claude-flow/swarm` 3.0.1 also fixes the `spawnAgent()` pool registration (#3539) and the event-driven `MessageBus` (#3563).
- CLI: string options keep their declared value (#3594, #3601), config cache isolated per project (#3590, #3591), nested config defaults cloned (#3595, #3600), hive consensus errors surface (#3609, #3654), `daemon start --workers` honoured (#3547, #3875).
- Plugins prefer the installed ruflo CLI (#3558, #3559, @HF-teamdev) and ruflo-adr edge keys are accepted by the memory validator (#3633, #3636, @drakeo338).
- `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.1: `mmrRerank()` caches cosine max-similarity (#3516, #3517).

### Breaking changes

- Off-loopback MCP HTTP binds (for example Docker with `--host 0.0.0.0`) need a token or the explicit opt-out.
- `hive-mind_init` no longer returns `hiveToken`.

### Packages

`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.55.0. Leaves: `shared` 3.0.2, `memory` 3.0.1, `swarm` 3.0.1, `security` 3.0.2, `mcp` 3.1.0, `plugin-agent-federation` 1.0.1.
Plugins: ruflo-adr 0.5.4, ruflo-goals 0.4.3, ruflo-cost-tracker 0.27.2, ruflo-metaharness 0.2.4, ruflo-console 0.36.1, ruflo-mods 0.3.15.

Full changelog: CHANGELOG.md. Release PR: #3890.

name: v3.54.1 — piped output, session export and AgentDB write fixes
body:
Ruflo 3.54.1 is a fixes release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` all at 3.54.1. `@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.1 was published first.

## Fixes (npm packages)
- #3851: piped output (`ruflo ... | consumer`) is no longer cut at 64 KiB. stdio is made blocking for pipes. Not tested on Windows.
- #3845: `session export --compress` now writes real gzip, and import detects it by magic bytes. Thanks @rudycelekli (PR #3848).
- #3840: YAML export preserves saved values. Thanks @rudycelekli (PR #3842).
- #3853: retry jitter is clamped to maxDelayMs.
- #3855: monitoring metrics expire by retention on read.
- #3841: WorkerQueue shutdown clears retry timers.
- #3844: hermetic statusline test.
- #3856: rate-limiter stats labels corrected.
- #3859: Porter stemmer step 4 uses the longest suffix. This changes stems for words like "document", so persisted BM25 indexes should be rebuilt.
- #3863: git workspace identity keeps trailing whitespace in path names.
- #3865: EventStore returns null for a missing snapshot (`@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.1, published first).
- #3691: `agentdb_pattern-store` and the bridge no longer acknowledge failed writes.
- #3693: the graph writer opens SQLite through the better-sqlite3 copy that agentdb resolves, so sidecars of a live AgentDB handle are no longer deleted.

Not fixed here: #3692 (covered by open PR #3831). Other read-write opens through the CLI's own better-sqlite3 copy (memory-distillation.ts, memory-backup.ts, distill-tuning.ts) could repeat the #3693 hazard; tracked for a follow-up.

## Plugins (git marketplace, not the npm tarballs)
ruflo-mods fixes (#3791 root-delete guard: backticks, `$'...'` escapes, abbreviated long options; #3793, #3795, #3798, #3801, #3803, #3805) and console security fixes (#3814, #3815, #3817, #3818 and part of #3816) reach you through the plugin marketplace:

    claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
    claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo
    claude plugin update ruflo-mods@ruflo

Then restart Claude Code.

Console 0.36.0 adds Events and Timeline pages with persistent history in `.claude-flow/console/` (`eventsPersist` option; local only). `ruflo init` now ignores `console/`.

## Known limits
- The recall-log from 3.54.0 is on by default (opt out with `RUFLO_RECALL_LOG=0`).
- Open lows from the Events review: rotation drops the older half, two consoles can overshoot the 2 MiB cap, and forget keeps pins and rules.
- CI timing tests were made robust (#3876) and a racy mock-ordering test fixed (#3881).
- #3802's wider risky-call set needs a maintainer decision.

name: v3.54.0 — console 0.35.0, measured control plane, recall log
body:
## Ruflo 3.54.0

### Console 0.35.0
- Layout fixes on the Workflows page: breadcrumbs, a clipped run id, button rows and the tab row.
- Replay now plays on its own clock.
- The control plane is now measured (Claude Code 2.1.289), not assumed:
  - Stopping a workflow run works with the Workflow tool's task id, read from the launching session's transcript. The earlier version used the wrong id: the `wf_` run id and the agent ids inside a run are refused by the engine.
  - A message to a running workflow agent is delivered in about 28 ms and acted on in about 1.6 s. To a named Agent-tool agent it lands at its next turn.
  - Permission dialogs are never bypassed. A mod cannot launch a workflow through `$.tool.call`.
- The mission autopilot is complete and was run live in a throwaway repo: envelope editor, bounded parallel hand-over, an honest spend estimate, and a band segment. The live run cost $0.356 on haiku and confirmed that Start asks first, verification runs, an out-of-envelope task is parked and never run, Stop takes 0.2 s, and a `kill -9` resume does not double-execute. Seven defects found live were fixed. Not exercised live: parallel hand-over, spend ceilings and the Anatole gate.
- Incremental transcript parsing: appending 50 lines to a 3 MB transcript went from about 38 ms to about 0.4 ms.

### npm packages carry new behaviour
- **Recall log, ON by default.** The intelligence hook now records which memories it surfaced (ids, scores, ranks and a 16-hex digest of the prompt, never the prompt text) in `.claude-flow/data/recall-log.jsonl`. It rotates at 1 MiB and stays local. Opt out with `RUFLO_RECALL_LOG=0` or `recallLog.enabled=false` in `claude-flow.config.json`.
  - Caveat: ids embed slugified memory headings.
  - Caveat: a short, predictable prompt can be confirmed by guessing against its digest.
- `memory list --embeddings` (read-only, 500 rows, int8) feeds the console's memory map.

### How the console reaches you
Through the git marketplace, not the npm tarballs:
```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo
```
Then restart Claude Code.

### Known limits
- About 190 ms of extra plugin load per start.
- Running all 25 kit tests at once under heavy load makes tests 3-8 time out at their own 5 s limits. The sequential runner `plugins/ruflo-console/scripts/kit-seq.sh` passes 216/216.
- The recall log appears only after helpers refresh to this release.
- Federation peer dispatch and OpenRouter itself were never called for real.
- 6 type errors remain in files other lanes own.

name: v3.53.0 - console 0.34.0: intelligence views, workflows board, control plane, mission autopilot
body:
## ruflo 3.53.0

The npm packages (`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo`) are a version bump plus a catalog entry. The big changes live in the console, ruflo-protector and mods plugins, which reach you through the git marketplace, not npm.

### What is new: ruflo-console 0.34.0

- **Intelligence views**: a memory map (a hash layout, labelled as such, not a similarity map), a learning pipeline and router picture, explain-a-recall with a pattern lifecycle, and memory health.
- **Workflows board**: phases, agents, model, tokens and time per run, with drill-down, search and logs, replay, compare, export, cost and a budget guard, triage, alerts, a worktree manager, templates, and Anatole per agent.
- **Control plane and multi-model bridge**: Stop, Message and Redirect through TaskStop and SendMessage, proven for Agent-tool background agents and **unverified for a workflow run's own agents**. A Conversation pane covers Claude, the hive, federation, Codex, and OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- **Mission autopilot**: one approved scope envelope, a journal, a kill switch, parking, and governed self-tuning that cannot widen its own envelope. **It has not yet run in a live interactive session**, and long runs need the session to stay alive.
- Three adversarial audits were run on the above.

### How to get it

npm: `npx ruflo@latest`. For the console, ruflo-protector and mods:

```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo
```

then restart Claude Code.

### Known limits

- About 190 ms extra plugin load per start (the engine transpiles the whole module graph). All 216 kit tests pass file by file, but 3 to 8 time out when all 25 files run at once under heavy load.
- npm Audit checks are red on main from newly published advisories in dependencies (proxy-addr, tinypool, and one more transitive). Being fixed separately.
- SendMessage delivery and agent control inside a workflow run are unverified.

name: v3.52.0: safer mods — guard holes 788 to 0, new optional abilities, Mods view in the console
body:
## In plain words

This release is about **making the plugin "mods" safer and easier to see**. Mods are the small background helpers that watch what Claude does (for example, refusing to save a password into memory). Overnight we tested every one of them hard, fixed the weak spots, and added a few optional new abilities.

**Now on npm too.** `ruflo`, `claude-flow` and `@claude-flow/cli` are published as **3.52.0** (all three tags: latest, alpha, v3alpha). The plugin changes below ship inside them and as marketplace plugin updates. `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` was published first to fix `bun add ruflo` (see below).

## Install fix: bun

`bun add ruflo` failed with "@claude-flow/codex missing version 3.0.3" (#3736). ruflo 3.51.1 asks for exactly codex 3.0.3, but only 3.0.2 existed on npm. npm hid this because it uses a bundled copy; bun does not. We published `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3`, then installed `ruflo` with bun in a clean folder: it now installs and runs (`ruflo v3.51.1`).

## What got safer

- **Secret guards no longer give up on big inputs.** Before, 32 guards could be skipped by sending a very large or deeply nested message. They now refuse such input instead. In our test run (3,182 attempts) the number of ways around a guard went from **788 to 0**.
- **Console:** at the "write" level Claude could run a shell command through the console. That is closed. "Always allow" can no longer skip your chosen control level, and auto-confirm never answers questions about network, spending or deleting.
- **Memory guard (agentdb):** it now catches secrets hidden with look-alike characters, and also checks the file you point `memory_import` at.
- **More secret-carrying tools are guarded**, and a status file that is really a link or folder is never read.

## What is new (all off by default)

Turn these on in `ruflo-mods` options if you want them:
- `agentTrim` — hides agent types you never use. Measured saving: **4,236 tokens** per session.
- `toolHints`, `deliveryScreen`, `capabilityProbe`, `sessionRollup`, `compactCarry` — extra hints, message screening, a self-check, a counts-only history, and carrying swarm/claims state through `/compact`.
- Console: a **Mods** section on the Room screen, clearer "waiting for you" banners, and a `drive.sh` script that lets a headless Claude click through the console for testing.

## Numbers

- Guard test holes: 788 → 0
- Plugin smoke checks: 47 of 47 pass
- Console tests: 1,106 pass
- Cost of all mod hooks on an unrelated tool call: about 19 microseconds

## What is NOT included

- No dependency pin changes. No leaf package source changed since 3.51.1.
- Draft PR #3751 (guard overlap) is not merged: it would make some guards weaker and needs a human decision.
- Still open: see the follow-up issue.

## How to update

npm: `npx ruflo@latest` or `bun add ruflo`. Plugins:

```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-mods@ruflo --scope user
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo --scope user
claude plugin update ruflo-agentdb@ruflo --scope user
```
(44 plugins changed in total; do the others the same way.) Then restart Claude Code.

72 pull requests, #3706 to #3784.

name: @claude-flow/codex 3.0.3 — fixes bun install of ruflo
body:
## Fix: `bun add ruflo` failed (#3736)

`ruflo` 3.51.1 depends on exactly `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3`, but that version had never been published to npm (latest was 3.0.2). npm did not notice because it uses a copy bundled inside the package; bun looks the version up in the registry and stopped with "missing version 3.0.3".

This release publishes `@claude-flow/codex@3.0.3` (the same source that was already in the repo). Nothing else changed.

**Checked:** 242 codex tests pass, the package contents are clean (120 files), and `bun add ruflo` in an empty folder now installs 586 packages and `ruflo --version` prints v3.51.1.

**Lesson for releases:** before merging a pin to a leaf package, check that `npm view <package>@<version>` returns it.

name: v3.51.1: security fixes for the pre-bash hook and MCP service destinations
body:
Security patch for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha` → 3.51.1). Upgrading is recommended.

**PreToolUse `pre-bash` denials now block (#3623).** When the hook handler recognised a denied command, it exited with status 1. Claude Code treats that as a non-blocking hook error, so the command could still run. Denials now exit 2, the status Claude Code's PreToolUse uses to block. The fix covers both shipped `hook-handler.cjs` copies and the handler `ruflo init` generates. Existing projects pick it up with `npx ruflo@latest init upgrade` (or a helper refresh).

**MCP tools send credentials only to configured services (#3624).** `x_federation_*` and `seraphina_guidance` read env-only credentials (`RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_KEY`). Their destinations are now pinned to the server-configured HTTPS base (`RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_URL`). A URL tool argument is only an assertion that must match that base; an absent, null or empty argument means no assertion. Every credential-bearing request rejects redirects. Operator configuration may name a loopback HTTP service for local or self-hosted gateways.

Verified: signed helper manifest at 3.51.1, witness manifests 117/117 on linux, macOS and Windows. A fresh `npx ruflo@3.51.1 init` writes the exit-2 handler.

name: v3.51.0: the /ruflo console
v3.50.0: ruflo as a Claude Code mod
body:
## ruflo 3.50.0: ruflo as a Claude Code mod

Install with `npx ruflo@latest`; `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` are all at 3.50.0.

Claude Code mods let a plugin hook the engine directly, as in-process TypeScript functions instead of shell commands. This release brings ruflo onto that API. It is **opt-in**: the classic hooks stay the default and the automatic fallback, and ruflo behaves exactly as before when function hooks are off.

### What's new
- **`ruflo mods install | uninstall | status | doctor | sync-policy`** and **`ruflo init --mods`** (ADR-404, #3608). Install writes only project-scoped files (`.claude/settings.local.json`, `.claude-flow/mods/install.json`).
- **The `ruflo-mods` plugin:**
  - **Routing:** in-process prompt routing, byte-identical to the classic `route` hook. In-process it takes 0.045 ms median versus 18.2 ms for a spawned hook.
  - **`tool.check`:** fed by ruflo policy, and it only ever tightens a verdict.
  - **Also:** edit learning signals, the cost budget ladder, and a status bar.
  - **`$.ruflo` noun:** `segment`, `lastRoute` and `snapshot`, so other mods (ruOS among them) can add to ruflo's status bar instead of drawing their own.
  - **Mod trust gate:** for mods loaded mid-session, including ones Claude writes. It only observes by default; `refuse-risky` is opt-in, and the allow-list matches the install source, not a self-declared name.
- **The `ruflo-swarm` pane mod 0.3.0** (#3607): a live pane with one tile per agent, which light up as agents read and write. It also shows the topology, the task and claims board, cost and tokens, the router's pick and hive-mind votes, and has buttons that act through the ruflo CLI. Claude Code subagents appear as tiles.
- **`ruflo-ruos`** (ADR-405, #3605): run swarm agents on your own ruOS cloud desktops.
  - **Transport:** only the tenant-authenticated fleet MCP and the ruOS jobs API (ADR-105). The unauthenticated desktop executor port is never used.
  - **Live run:** a live run on a real desktop passed, and the desktop was stopped and verified afterwards.
- **`ruflo-plugin-creator` 0.3.0:** a `create-mod` skill and template for scaffolding governed mods.

### Requirements and caveats
- Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or newer**, where mods are on by default. Versions 2.1.277–2.1.286 need `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1`.
- Anthropic's rollout switch must also be on for your account. `ruflo mods doctor` reports its state, and it flipped during development.
- The mods API is early access and may change.

### Verified
- **Registry:** latest, alpha and v3alpha are 3.50.0 for all three packages.
- **Fresh install:** `npm i ruflo@3.50.0` gives `ruflo v3.50.0`; `mods install`, `status` and `doctor` work and write only inside the project.
- **Plugin tests:** engine-kit tests pass on 2.1.287 (ruflo-mods 16/16, ruflo-swarm 38/38, ruflo-ruos 3/3), and `claude plugin validate` passes for all three.
- **Release integrity:** the witness passes 117/117 on linux, macos and windows, and the signed helper manifest verifies.

Coordinated with the ruOS lane: `@cognitum/ruos` 0.3.0 ships the ruOS mod and the jobs API clients.

name: v3.49.0: eleven reported issues fixed (Martin Vladimirov), Nick Ruest and drakeo338 contributions
body:
## ruflo 3.49.0

Install: `npx ruflo@latest` (also `@claude-flow/cli@3.49.0`, `claude-flow@3.49.0`). `@claude-flow/security@3.0.1` is bundled and published standalone.

This release fixes eleven issues reported by **Martin Vladimirov (@martinvlad)**. Each report included measurements and a reproduction, and that is what made fixing them quick. It also includes two PRs from **Nick Ruest (@nicholas-ruest)** and one from **@drakeo338**.

### Fixes
- **#3555: helpers load in `"type":"module"` projects.** `router`, `session` and `memory` now ship as `.cjs`, so ESM projects no longer get "Router not available" (#3583).
- **#3565: post-install helper tampering is detected and healed.** An integrity re-check runs even when the version stamp matches, contributed by Nick Ruest (#3576). `doctor` now reports it as well (#3583).
- **#3567: `hooks_route` no longer reports high confidence on no match.** It used to report 70% when nothing matched; it now returns 30% with `matched:false` / `no-match-default`. Whitespace-only tasks are rejected (#3581).
- **#3568: policy ledger truncation is now detectable.** The ledger records its head anchor and length; this change is in `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.1 (#3579).
- **#3557: plugin install trust policy.** Install scripts are gated (#3580).
- **#3556: ai-team discovery uses a CORS allowlist.** 0.1.6 is live on team.ruv.io (#3577).
- **#3566: sibling-namespace disclosure.** Partial matches are disclosed, and import reports real vector counts (#3582).
- **#3570: memory key and namespace validation.** One shared validator covers the CLI and MCP; contributed by @drakeo338 (#3571).
- **#3572: `swarm status` progress.** It reports `null` instead of invented numbers (#3578).
- **#3573, #3575: session import and memory fixes** (#3584).
- **doctor native-driver detection.** The better-sqlite3 loader is now injectable; contributed by Nick Ruest (#3569).

### Verified on the published packages
Fresh `npm i ruflo@3.49.0` in a `"type":"module"` project: helpers install as `.cjs` and routing works; no-match routes report 30%; `swarm status` progress is `null`; a tampered `router.cjs` is detected and restored. Witness manifests verify 117/117 on linux, macos and windows, and the signed helper manifest verifies.

Thanks to Martin, Nick and drakeo338.

name: @claude-flow/plugins 3.0.1 — SQL-injection fix in the RuVector GNN SQL builders
body:
## Security fix: SQL injection in the RuVector GNN SQL builders

`npm install @claude-flow/plugins@3.0.1`. All dist-tags (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha`) point to 3.0.1.

**Who is affected:** code that calls the SQL-generating methods in `integrations/ruvector/gnn.ts` with input it doesn't fully control, then runs the result against PostgreSQL/RuVector. This applies to `@claude-flow/plugins` **3.0.0 and earlier**. Affected methods: `BaseGNNLayer.toSQL()` (every GNN layer), `GraphOperations.kHopNeighborsSQL/shortestPathSQL/pageRankSQL/communityDetectionSQL`, and the `GNNSQLGenerator` static builders. `gnn.js` isn't in the package's `exports` map, so it is only reachable by importing the file by path.

**What was wrong:** node ids, `source`/`target` and the community algorithm name were placed inside single quotes (`WHERE target_id = '${nodeId}'`), so a `'` broke out of the literal. `schema`/`table`/`edgeTable`/`cacheTable` identifiers were wrapped in `"…"`, which doesn't help when the value contains `"`. `nodeColumn` wasn't quoted at all. Numbers (`k`, `damping`, `maxIterations`, `resolution`, `dimension`), layer-config JSON and the prepared-statement `paramPrefix` were interpolated unchecked.

**What changed:** every interpolation now goes through a validator. Identifiers must match `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` and are quoted. Strings are single-quote-escaped. Numbers must be finite, or integers with a minimum where that makes sense. JSON config is escaped before it is embedded in `jsonb`. Unsafe input throws `TypeError` instead of producing SQL. Legitimate input produces the same SQL as before, except that `nodeColumn` is now quoted. This mirrors the `attention.ts` hardening in #3530.

**What to do:** upgrade to 3.0.1. There are no API changes. If you pass non-plain identifiers (such as `my-table` or `schema.table` strings), the builders now reject them, so map them to plain identifiers first.

## Verification
- A new 25-test injection suite fails 22 tests against the old code and passes against the fix. The full plugins suite (473 passed / 3 skipped) is unchanged, and all 110 CI checks passed on the release PR.
- **Published artifact:** in a fresh `npm install` of 3.0.1, an exploit smoke test passes 8/8. Against 3.0.0 as a control, the same test fails 7/8.
- **Tarball:** the registry tarball is file-for-file identical to `npm pack` of a clean build at `3bcf7e96a`. `dist.integrity` is `sha512-cl86h1eEs5sgCRtenrh4XablDmSQmSEjZRaYOOdwUDMRBz38O1NymS4KJyfVWA49nJ/2A4jIlHi1GtBipxbodw==`.

Fixes #3531 · Fix: #3564 · Release: #3574

This is a standalone `@claude-flow/plugins` release. The `@claude-flow/cli` / `claude-flow` / `ruflo` train is unchanged (latest train release: v3.48.0).

**Full write-up** (affected surface, before/after examples, validation, artifact integrity): https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/1cb9c6894394d5f51cf9e8f52b2ddcc4

| `@claude-flow/memory`, `neural`, `shared`, `security`, `mcp` (and the other internal leaves) | 3.0.0 |
| `@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation`, `plugin-iot-cognitum` | 1.0.0 |

`@claude-flow/embeddings` stays on its alpha line for now.

## Also in this release
- **Guarded public federation registration** (first shipped in 3.47.0 from a release branch) is now on `main`, so this release keeps it.
- **SQL-injection hardening** in the `@claude-flow/plugins` ruvector attention SQL builders. Follow-up for `gnn.ts`: #3531.
- **Smaller, cleaner leaf tarballs.** A `files` allowlist on every leaf stops local runtime state (logs, pids, `settings.json`) from being packed. The three affected alpha versions are deprecated.

name: v3.46.1 — Windows browser tools no longer pass tool input through a shell
body:
## Security fix: Windows browser MCP tools

**Who is affected:** Windows hosts running the RuFlo browser MCP tools (`browser_open`, `browser_fill`, `browser_type`, `browser_eval` and the other `browser_*` tools) where `agent-browser` is **not** installed globally, so the tools fall back to `npx`. Every published version that carries the #2770 fallback is affected, including 3.46.0. macOS and Linux were never affected.

**What was wrong:** the `npx` fallback ran through the Windows command shell so `npx.cmd` could be resolved. Values supplied to the browser tools (fill text, eval scripts, selectors) were passed on that command line and could be interpreted as shell syntax.

**What changed:** the launcher now resolves the npm shims to the process behind them and starts it directly with an argument array. No shell is involved, and no tool value is ever parsed as a command. If the launcher cannot be resolved without a shell, the tool reports the install hint instead of falling back to one. Details and the alternatives considered are in ADR-401.

**What to do:** upgrade to 3.46.1. Installing `agent-browser` globally (`npm i -g agent-browser`) also avoids the fallback path on older versions.

The same change was audited across the other places that set `shell` on Windows (`init`, `eject`, `agentbbs`); none receives tool-supplied input.

## Verification
A regression test drives the browser tools with shell metacharacters under both a Windows and a Linux platform and asserts each value reaches the process as a single literal argument. It fails on the previous code, and a static guard fails if a `shell` option is reintroduced.

Full details: #3451.



**Full write-up** (review method, validation, artifact integrities, what was held and why): https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/d7c5a6f1c3616dbbc6db91fdafb1db32

name: v3.46.0 — 29 reviewed fixes, and the standalone packages that were silently skipping them
body:
## What changed

29 reviewed PRs landed together, plus the memory fix that #3352 needed. Every diff was read by a security reviewer first; the combined tree was built and tested before it merged.

**Fixes that were silently not working**
- Daemon YAML config was ignored under ESM (#3420); a stale daemon state could end a fresh session (#3421).
- Workflow steps with hyphenated names never interpolated (#3422).
- MCP policy enforcement (`RUFLO_MCP_ENFORCE_POLICY`) was skipped by the shipped stdio launchers (#3423).
- A late HTTP timeout could double-write a response (#3426).
- `memory_retrieve` served stale values when two servers shared a store (#3361); `mcp start` on stdio no longer SIGKILLs a sibling server (#3365); a dead process no longer holds `state.lock` for 30 s (#3363).
- `--no-codex-detect` was never honoured (#3434); agent `instructions` were ignored at execution (#3429); browser errors now surface the real detail (#3430).
- `EWCConsolidator` EMA direction was inverted (#3395); MoE load-balance loss was computed but never applied (#3330); swarm leader edges were never mirrored (#3357).

**Security**
- Namespace/key collisions in the memory upsert no longer delete distinct entries (#3352 + #3359).
- `validateEnv()` denylist gains the PATH / search-path family (#3385).
- Background `git` calls neutralise repo-local `core.fsmonitor` (#3382, partial: see below).
- `github-safe.js` regression gate covers all three shipped helper copies (#3412).
- Plugin scripts stop running `npx` at tool-call time (#3367).

**New**
- `witness verify --strict` (#3424), `--request-timeout-ms` for the HTTP MCP transport (#3426), a doctor check for `agent-browser` (#3441), native AgentDB integrity check in doctor (#3431), Simplified Chinese README (#3316).

## Upgrade notes
- `embeddings init` and `models --download` now **exit 1** when `@claude-flow/embeddings` is not installed (#3379). Scripts that ran them bare will start failing.
- `sonaTracksGlobal` in unified stats changes from boolean to `null` (#3439).
- MoE load-balance loss is now **on by default** for existing persisted models (#3330).
- `globalFisher` now moves about 100x slower per update after the EMA direction fix (#3395).
- Three packages resolve from the registry rather than the release tarballs, and were published standalone first: `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.0-alpha.26, `@claude-flow/neural` 3.0.0-alpha.10, `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.0-alpha.6. The CLI pins all three exactly.

## Known gaps
- #3382 only neutralises `core.fsmonitor`. `core.hooksPath`, `filter.*`, `diff.external`, `core.sshCommand`, `GIT_CONFIG_*` and about 15 raw `git` callers are still exposed. #3385's denylist omits `GIT_CONFIG_*` and `HOME`.
- The published `@claude-flow/mcp@3.0.0-alpha.9` still ships the shell-string `github-safe.js` reported in #3411. The source has been shell-free for some time; a corrected `mcp` publish needs its own decision.

Not included (held for changes): #3333, #3268, #3339, #3393, #3369, #3387, #3425, #3428, #3432, #3433, #3435, #3437, #3440, #3442, #3341, #3373, #3438, #3295, #3296, #3298, #3270, #3307, #3309, #3310.

name: v3.45.0 — upgrades stop leaving a stale memory package behind
body:
# RuFlo 3.45.0: upgrades stop leaving a stale memory package behind

**Released 24 September 2026.** Upgrade:

```sh
npx ruflo@latest --version    # should print: ruflo v3.45.0
```

---

## The short version

- **A fix that spans two packages now reaches you together.** `npx @claude-flow/cli@latest` reuses one cache folder across versions, and npm keeps an older `@claude-flow/memory` that still fits the allowed range. So an upgrade could quietly leave you on the old memory package, with nothing reporting a problem. The CLI now asks for one exact memory version, so a stale copy can no longer pass. (#3392)
- **`ruflo doctor` tells you when it happens anyway.** A new check, `@claude-flow/memory version`, compares the memory package the CLI actually loads with the one it asks for. If they differ it warns and prints the command to clear the cache. It is a warning, not a failure, so it never changes doctor's exit code. Try it with `ruflo doctor --component memory-package`.
- **Running the test suite no longer edits your own config.** One test ran the real `init` against your home folder, adding to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.codex/config.toml` and leaving a background download running. It now uses a throwaway home. This is a test-only change. (#3370)

## Checked

With memory `alpha.24` already installed, adding the old `cli@3.44.0` left it at `alpha.24`. Adding the published `cli@3.45.0` upgraded it to `alpha.25`, and the new check reports it satisfied.

## Known gaps

- The `ruflo` wrapper still allows any `@claude-flow/cli` from 3.33.0 up, so `npx ruflo@latest` can still run an older cached CLI (#3306). Use an explicit version when checking.
- The signed witness manifests were regenerated from a source-only checkout. The entries that point at build output are carried forward unchanged, not re-checked, so their "verified" count is not fresh. A regeneration on a fully built tree is the follow-up.
- `@claude-flow/mcp` on npm still ships the old shell-based `github-safe.js` helper (#3411). The fix is in review as #3412 and is not part of this release.

name: v3.44.0 — the agent picker gets fixed on your machine, and gets measured
body:
# RuFlo 3.44.0: the agent picker gets fixed on your machine, and gets measured

**Released 23 September 2026.** Upgrade:

```sh
npx ruflo@latest --version    # should print: ruflo v3.44.0
```

---

## The short version

- **The word-matching fix from 3.43.0 now reaches your computer.** The file that picks agents for your prompts was never updated after it was first installed. It now updates itself.
- **A new, optional, smarter agent picker** uses a real language model instead of comparing spelling. It's off by default. Turn it on with one setting.
- **We built a test to decide which picker should be the default**, and ran it. The honest result: none of the new options met the bar yet, so the default stays as it is. The numbers are below.

---

## 1. Your installed agent picker now updates itself

Every time you type a prompt in Claude Code, RuFlo's hook suggests which kind of agent should handle it. It does this with a small file, `router.js`, in `~/.claude/helpers/`.

3.43.0 fixed a bug where it matched parts of words: "review the la**test** issues" went to the *tester* because "latest" contains "test". **But the fix never reached anyone.** `router.js` was written once, when RuFlo was first set up, and upgrades never replaced it. On the maintainer's own machine, it was from April.

**Now `router.js` is one of the signed files RuFlo keeps up to date.** The next time you run any `ruflo` command, it checks the file against a cryptographically signed list and replaces it if it's out of date:

| Prompt | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| "sync and review latest issues" | tester | reviewer |
| "are we uing typesafe" (typo) | frontend-dev (because of "ui") | coder |
| "write unit tests for the auth module" | tester | tester |

*(ADR-389)*

## 2. Optional: a picker that understands meaning

RuFlo also has a second, "semantic" picker (`hooks route`). Until now it compared **spelling patterns**, not meaning. That's why it still thought "latest" looked like "test".

RuFlo already ships a real language model (MiniLM) for its memory search. 3.44.0 lets the picker use it too:

```sh
export CLAUDE_FLOW_ROUTER_EMBEDDER=minilm
npx ruflo hooks route --task "fix the login crash"
#  default picker: tester  ✗
#  with minilm:    coder   ✓
```

It costs about 5 extra milliseconds per prompt, plus a one-time model load of about 0.3 seconds. If the model isn't available, it quietly uses the old method and tells you so in its output (`embedder=hash`). *(ADR-390)*

## 3. How we decided what the default should be

Instead of guessing, we built a test (ADR-391):

- **197 realistic requests**, the kind people really type, each labelled with the right agent. A third are deliberately tricky ("the author field is missing in the prefix list" is a coding job, not an auth one).
- **Labelled blind.** The person doing the labelling never saw what any picker chose.
- **Frozen.** The list is locked with a checksum, so it can't be quietly adjusted later.

Then we ran four pickers on the same held-out 113 requests:

| Picker | Got it right | Time per prompt (95th percentile) |
|---|---|---|
| Current default | **26%** | 1.1 ms |
| With the language model (new option above) | **36%** | 6.2 ms |
| typesafe, basic | 27% | 1.2 ms |
| typesafe, with a model | 29% (44% before its safety gate) | 8.3 ms |

**The rule for changing the default** was set *before* running the test: more than 2 points more accurate, no new required download, and no more than 5% slower. The language-model option is clearly more accurate (+10 points) but is 5 ms slower, which breaks the "5% slower" rule because the current picker only takes 1 ms. So **the default did not change**, and the rule was not bent to make it pass.

**What the test taught us** (these are the next steps):

1. **The picker can't give the right answer for about 30% of requests.** It has no category for "researcher", "reviewer" or "not an engineering task at all". Adding those will probably help more than any model change.
2. **The speed rule should probably be an absolute limit** (say, under 10 ms), not "5% slower than 1 ms". That's a decision for the maintainers, recorded in the ADR, and not changed quietly here.
3. **The typesafe picker is the most accurate when it answers (44%)**, but its "am I sure?" check is too strict and lets it answer only 6% of the time. That needs tuning.

## Also fixed

- A test for the optional typesafe picker had been failing on the main branch since 3.43.0. It expected the old "latest → tester" mistake. It now checks the right thing.

## How this release was checked

- Every required release test passed:
  - codex 241
  - security 583
  - federation 640
  - 121 CLI tests, including all new router tests
- The five signed helper files were verified against the signed list.
- The packed release was installed into an empty folder and tested:
  - A deliberately out-of-date `router.js` was replaced after one `ruflo` command, and it stopped sending "latest" to the tester.
  - The language-model option picked "coder" for "fix the login crash", where the default picks "tester".

## Full details

- ADRs: 389 (keep the picker updated), 390 (language-model option), 391 (the test and its results): `v3/docs/adr/`
- The test set and the script to re-run it: `v3/@claude-flow/cli/benchmarks/router/`
- Pull request: #3410
